committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 9 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Weekly ad spend rose to A$147.52 from A$124.68 on 24 clicks at a CPC of A$6.15, with conversionsLast7 still at zero.
Impression share sits at just 10% over 30 days, with rank lost at 73.8 points well ahead of budget lost at 20.9, so quality or ad strength looks like the bigger cap on reach than budget right now.
Of the first 11 landing page test clicks, 2 ask_cta_click events have fired and zero review_cta_click, while /free-workflow-review.html matched the homepage on sessions this week (20 each).
AI Assistant sessions rose to 4 from 1 this week, led by claude-check, though this undercounts true AI referral traffic; LinkedIn held at zero despite Chris's posting there.

actions.text: Paid clicks on the landing page test have crossed 10 (now 11 raw). Review search terms and Clarity recordings now and log any exclusions in the test log.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these finalised.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. Update them to match current site stats.

weekly: 11 raw paid clicks and A$71.36 spent since 6 Oct, with A$474.45 of the A$600 credit left and no qualified enquiries logged yet.
last7 sessions rose to 64 from 53 (up 21%), though Thu 8 sat at 7 versus 11 on the same weekday last week.
generate_lead stayed at zero again this week, with 3 form starts not yet converting; any future enquiry still needs grading against the qualified rule.
sessions from AI referrers rose to 4 from 1, led by claude-check, though this likely undercounts since many AI clicks land as Direct.
Search Console data (through 6 Oct) shows just 7 clicks from 196 impressions over 8 days, with SimPRO-related queries still ranking in the 30s and 40s.
